title: Bali Honeymoon Special | From Offbeat Roads to Sunlit Shores
highlights: From Ubud’s cultural gems, Kuta’s lively beaches, and Sidemen’s vast rice terraces, discover the best of Bali, blending adventure and traditions in one memorable journey.
Dine with royalty with a complimentary upgrade to a 5-star candlelight dinner at Mamaka by Ovolo, where gourmet flavors and beachside beauty create a memorable evening.
Turn moments with a complimentary 1-hour photoshoot at Sari Timbul, where Bali’s exotic beaches and lush backdrops transform every frame into a perfect picture.
Unwind in pure bliss at Bali’s most handpicked spas, where age-old healing rituals meet modern luxury, and exclusive discounts of up to 50% make indulgence irresistible.
Escape into ultimate indulgence with the best deals on Ubud’s private pool villas, where infinity pools and jungle panoramas redefine absolute luxury living.
overview:
About the Tour:
Embark on a magical journey through Bali, where every day blends scenic beauty, cultural richness, and unforgettable experiences. Begin in the tranquil highlands of Sidemen, exploring hidden waterfalls, lush rice terraces, and local craftsmanship. Also, discover East Bali’s gems like Tirta Gangga, Lempuyang Temple, and Bukit Cinta. Cruise to Nusa Penida to witness dramatic cliffs and snorkel in crystal-clear waters. Also, relax with a traditional Balinese massage before visiting Uluwatu Temple for a stunning sunset and the captivating Kecak Dance. With romantic dinners, coastal views, and serene stays, this tour captures Bali’s charm at every turn.

know_before_you_go: Visa on Arrival (VOA) for Indonesia is not included in your package and must be obtained and paid for at the airport upon your arrival. Please ensure you have the necessary documents ready.
Complimentary activities included in your package are provided as a value addition, but if any of these are missed for any reason, they cannot be refunded, exchanged, or compensated.

Where your itinerary mentions “local lunch,” it refers to an authentic Balinese meal featuring traditional flavors and dishes. Indian food will not be served during these local lunch experiences unless specifically mentioned.
Vehicles will follow a fixed point-to-point route as per the itinerary. Any changes or additional sightseeing requests may incur extra charges.
Bahasa Indonesia is the official language, and Balinese is also widely spoken. However, English is commonly understood in most tourist areas.
The local currency is the Indonesian Rupiah (IDR). While credit cards are accepted in many restaurants and hotels, cash is often preferred in smaller shops and markets.
When visiting temples or sacred sites, dress respectfully: cover your shoulders and knees, and wear a sarong and sash when required (often available at the entrance).

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Ubud | Day at Leisure
days.desc: Welcome! Upon arriving at the airport, get driven to the hotel. After you check in, you can either rleax for the day or explore Ubud at your leisure. You can either dine at Mozaic Ubud, a world-renowned fine dining restaurant known for its Balinese flavors. Alternatively, you can visit Ubud Palace, the royal residence that showcases intricate Balinese architecture & traditional carvings. For a playful break, you can be at Bali Fun World, one of Indonesia’s largest indoor playgrounds.

days.title: Central Bali Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: After having a delicious floating breakfast, set out for a day to explore Bali’s highlights. Begin with Bali Swing, where you glide above lush valleys. Continue to Tegenungan Waterfall, a serene jungle spot ideal for relaxation & photos, followed by a visit to Tirta Empul, a revered water temple famed for its holy springs & spiritual ambience. Capture timeless moments with 1-hour photoshoot at Sari Timbul, then journey through Tegallalang Rice Terrace. Later, get driven back to the hotel.

items.desc: 1 X Vintage Volkswagen will be Provided

items.title: Central Bali Sightseeing Tour with Tirta Empul Temple - Bali Swing + Tegenungan Waterfall + Tirta Empul + Sari Timbul + Tegallang Rice Terrace Tour on a Vintage Volkswagen

days.title: East Bali Sightseeing & Sidemen Rice Terrace Tour | Transfer to Sidemen
days.desc: Check out from the hotel & get driven to discover the scenic gems of East Bali, beginning with Tirta Gangga, a former royal water palace adorned with tiered fountains. Continue to Lempuyang Temple, where Mount Agung rises dramatically in the backdrop. Also, soak in panoramic views at Bukit Cinta Viewpoint, overlooking rice fields & volcanic landscapes, followed by a visit to Sidemen Rice Terrace, known for its lush greenery. Afterwards, get driven to Sidemen. Upon arrival, check in at the hotel.

items.title: East Bali Tour - Tirta Gangga + Lempuyang Temple + Bukit Cinta with Sidemen Rice Terrace

days.title: Visit to Besaikh Temple & Telaga Waja River & Waterfall
days.desc: Set out to explore Bali’s spiritual & natural treasures, beginning with Besakih Temple, island’s largest & holiest temple, set on the slopes of Mount Agung. Afterwards, visit the scenic Telaga Waja River, flowing through lush valleys & rice fields. Here, you can choose to enjoy a thrilling rafting adventure (at an extra cost) or simply relax & admire the serene beauty of the river. Conclude the experience with a visit to a nearby Telaga Fall, where refreshing cascades create a perfect ending.

items.title: Besaikh Temple & Telaga Waja River & Waterfall Tour

days.title: Balinese Massage & Candlelight Dinner Experience | Transfer to Kuta
days.desc: Today, check out of the hotel & enjoy a Balinese massage, a traditional therapy that combines gentle stretches, acupressure & aromatherapy oils to ease tension & leave you completely refreshed. After this rejuvenating experience, get transferred to Kuta & check in at the hotel. In the evening, indulge in a romantic candlelight dinner at Mamaka by Ovolo’s rooftop, where panoramic ocean views & a gourmet 5-star menu create an unforgettable dining experience. Later, get driven back to the hotel.

items.title: Balinese Massage in Bali - 1-Hour Balinese Massage in Kuta
Check-in at Standard Hotel
items.hotel: Cross Vibe Paasha Atelier Bali Kuta

items.title: Candle Light Dinner at Mamaka by Ovolo

days.title: Nusa Penida West Tour
days.desc: In the morning, get driven to Sanur to board a speedboat to Nusa Penida Island. Upon arrival, marvel at the T-Rex–shaped cliffs of Kelingking Beach before visiting Angel’s Billabong, a natural infinity pool with crystal-clear waters, and the dramatic rock arch of Broken Bay. Continue to Paluang Cliff for sweeping views of Kelingking from a unique angle, and unwind at Crystal Bay, where calm shores and golden sands make for the perfect tropical escape. Later, get driven back to the hotel.

items.title: Transfer in Speed Boat
items.desc: 1 X Speed Boat will be Provided

Transfer in Speed Boat

days.title: Water Sports at Tanjung Benoa Beach | Uluwatu Sunset Tour with Kecak Fire Show | Visit to Kuta Market
days.desc: Today, you'll be driven to Tanjung Benoa Beach, Bali’s water sports hub & enjoy water sports like jet skiing, parasailing & banana boat rides, offering an adrenaline kick. Then, visit Melasti Beach, a pristine stretch framed by dramatic limestone cliffs & turquoise waters. Later, visit the iconic Uluwatu Temple, perched high above the ocean & witness the Kecak Dance against a golden sunset. Conclude the day exploring the vibrant stalls of Kuta Market. Later, get driven back to the hotel.

days.desc: Post check out, get driven to the airport for your flight back home. This marks the end of your amazing Bali family tour!
